steps.path: Open a document → Comments → Shrink panel → hover a highlight
steps.headline: The narrow view keeps hoverable highlights, with no slim comment rail.
steps.changed: Shrinking now returns to the normal hover-comment view instead of leaving the marker strip behind. The full comments panel is still available through Comments.
steps.notice: The document gets its width back. Hover a marked passage or cell to read its comment; the floating card uses the same frosting as the approved comment composer and right-click menus.
steps.risk: On touchscreens, tap a highlight to open the comment card instead of hovering. This changes only the narrow view; the full comments panel keeps its existing layout.

steps.path: Session files → launch-brief.docx → Comments → Shrink panel
steps.headline: Try expanding and shrinking comments, then hover a marked passage.
steps.hint: Open Session files and choose launch-brief.docx. Press Comments to open the full panel, then Shrink panel. The slim strip should be gone and hovering marked text should show its comment. Press Comments again: the full panel should reopen on the first click.
steps.changed: Shrink leaves Comments mode rather than keeping an invisible panel state. The next Comments click can open the full panel normally.
steps.notice: There are two views now: hover comments while narrow, and the full comments panel when expanded.
steps.risk: Practice files and a fake backend only; this preview does not change your real documents. The previously approved comment-composer frosting is retained.
